description: This file is a PHPUnit test case class for EmployeeTimeAtWorkDao in the OrangeHRM Dashboard plugin, specifically testing methods related to employee attendance records retrieval and manipulation.

classes.name: EmployeeTimeAtWorkDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test case class for EmployeeTimeAtWorkDao, testing retrieval of latest attendance records and attendance records by date for employees.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, instantiates EmployeeTimeAtWorkDao, and populates test data from YAML fixture.

methods.name: testGetLatestAttendanceRecordByEmpNumber
methods.description: Tests retrieving the latest attendance record for a specific employee number, verifying the record's state and punch times.

methods.name: testGetAttendanceRecordsByEmployeeAndDate
methods.description: Tests retrieving attendance records for an employee within a date range, verifying record count and details for specific employee IDs and date intervals.
